question: According to Article 24 of the Constitution of India, a person below ___ years of age shall not be employed to work in any factory.
solution:
The correct answer is **__14.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **According to Article 24 of the Constitution of India, a person below 14 years of age shall not be employed to work in any factory.**
 
• **Prohibition of Employment of Children:**
 
 
• Article 24 prohibits the employment of children
